name: Anakin Padme 4 Panel
meaning: Anakin states a plan; Padme smiles and asks a hopeful follow-up; Anakin just stares; Padme's smile fades as she repeats the question. For a plan whose obvious good intention is suspiciously not confirmed.
when_to_use: text1 = Anakin's statement of the plan (top left). text2 = Padme's hopeful assumption, usually "[good outcome], right?" (top right). Bottom left has no box: Anakin's silent stare is the beat. text3 = Padme repeating the same question, now worried (bottom right).
